title: Isodiametric volume bound for the closed image of a Lipschitz map
statement: Let X be a metric space, m ∈ ℕ, D ⊆ X an arbitrary subset, K ∈ ℝ≥0, and f : X → ℝᵐ (ℝᵐ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) = Rn m with Lebesgue measure Lᵐ = volume) K-Lipschitz on D, i.e. edist (f x) (f x') ≤ K·edist x x' for all x, x' ∈ D. Then Lᵐ(closure f(D)) ≤ ω_m · K^m · (ediam D)^m / 2^m in [0,∞], where ω_m = Chapter01.realUnitBallVolume m, ediam is the extended diameter (ediam ∅ = 0), and K^m, (ediam D)^m, 2^m are natural powers. No measurability, boundedness or finiteness assumption is made; m = 0 and K = 0 are allowed.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] (m : ℕ) (D : Set X) (f : X → Rn m) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith K f D → volume (closure (f '' D)) ≤ Chapter01.realUnitBallVolume (m : ℝ) * (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * ediam D ^ m / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m
